title: 2108 Prairie's basement lights stand tall and barred, as sketched in 1898
items: 2108 Prairie, the Mark Kimball house, now has the tall iron-barred basement lights the Tribune's 1898 sketch shows: each about two thirds of the basement's height under a curved head of iron, set in a stone base of four courses, where before they were short, plain windows half that height. The house now matches its picture.
